title: fix(cli): accept SSE data without a trailing space
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16214

- Accepts valid SSE data frames with or without the optional space after the colon, avoiding silently empty output or swallowed provider errors.
- Preserves spaced-frame parsing, content, metadata and `[DONE]` handling with a two-line runtime change.
- Adds four direct-parser regression cases using native `Response` bodies. The two unspaced cases fail on main and pass with the fix.
- Keeps this compatibility change separate from reader cleanup #16208. Live gateway use of unspaced frames has not been observed.

Verification: 253 tests across 30 files passed; ESM/declaration build, scoped strict TypeScript and Biome passed. Three localhost-server suites were excluded because this environment blocks socket binding. Local tests used cached Vitest 2.1.9 rather than the declared ^3.0.0; no dependencies or lockfiles changed.

gist.headline: One less space to worry about
gist.blurb: The CLI reads SSE messages whether or not there’s a space after `data:`. A tiny parsing fix keeps output and provider errors from disappearing into the shrubbery.
gist.summary: The Polli CLI parser accepts SSE `data:` frames with or without an optional space after the colon, while preserving spaced frames, metadata, and `[DONE]` handling.
gist.impact: CLI users get message content and provider errors from either valid frame format instead of silently empty output when the space is absent.
